g.text: Gregory_House. No word from the passes yet. When there is, you've
earned the hearing of it. Until then, my city is yours to wander.
1. What does a king do all day?
One of King Selwyn's own guard, in polished plate and a white cloak. They stand very still, and they miss nothing.
If it's a petition, it goes to the herald. If it's a bill, it comes to me, and I'm sorry for both
of us. Chancellor Valeria. What is it?
